description: Hold TypeScript below 7 until @astrojs/check supports it. 0.9.10 (latest) declares peerDependencies typescript ^5.0.0 || ^6.0.0, so a v7 bump cannot resolve — which is why Renovate's PR #12 changed package.json without ever producing a package-lock.json update, leaving a tree that `npm ci` refuses to install.
Nothing in the build needs v7: `npm run build` is `astro build`, and typescript is here for @astrojs/check and editor tooling only.
TO LIFT: check whether @astrojs/check has widened its peer range (npm view @astrojs/check peerDependencies), then delete this rule.
